attachments.displayName: Thomas & Betts E987NR Junction Box Cover by Dillon1337 - Thingiverse

object.content:
Last night I started designing my first object for 3D printing. You can view it here: http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:27291. It's for my Automatic Garden Waterer project (http://tinkeringetc.blogspot.com/2012/06/automatic-garden-waterer-part-1.html) that I am re-doing with an Arduino and 16x2 character LCD. If you check out my blog, you'd see that I mutilated the previous cover so I wanted a replacement. I think I found the right replacement lid in Lowe's, but it was over $10 -- nearly the same price as the entire junction box. I first plan on creating a solid lid (as you see here), and then creating a derivative with the cutout for the LCD, buttons, and mounting holes.

I spent a lot of time trying to print it out last night but my Printrbot was not having it. The large first layer was the culprit. The print wasn't sticking and I am still unsure what part of the bed is giving me troubles -- if it's the temperature, surface, or leveling of the bed. I think I'll start with some smaller prints first and work my way up because I've printed out three objects so far that are a couple square inches with no problems.
